description_en: Queries materials that are waiting to be edited in an online editing project
description_zh: 调用本接口获取云剪辑工程的待剪辑素材列表
kebab_example: aliyun vod get-editing-project-materials --project-id 19823610110933740000 --type video --material-type video --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetEditingProjectMaterials

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the online editing project. You can use one of the following methods to obtain the ID of the online editing project:

*   Log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com). In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Production Center** > **Video Editing** to obtain the ID of the specified online editing project.
*   Call the **AddEditingProject** operation. The value of the response parameter ProjectId is the ID of the specified online editing project.
parameters.description_zh:
云剪辑工程ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**制作中心** > **视频剪辑**，查看ID。
- 通过**创建云剪辑工程**接口创建工程时，为返回参数ProjectId的值。
